nodes.title: Z-Image · Imagen y prompt
widgets_values:
A single ultra-realistic studio reference photograph of an adult woman, 30 years old, standing upright in a relaxed neutral anatomical pose, directly facing the camera.

Perfectly frontal view, straight head position, natural symmetrical posture, shoulders level, both arms resting naturally at her sides, unobstructed torso. Framing from the top of the head to the upper hips.

Natural adult female anatomy, realistic body proportions, naturally shaped breasts with anatomically accurate areolas and nipples, believable skin elasticity, subtle natural asymmetry, authentic skin pores, fine skin texture and realistic anatomical transitions.

Natural facial features, relaxed expression, both eyes focused straight ahead, realistic eye alignment, subtle facial asymmetry, no makeup, natural eyebrows.

Professional full-frame DSLR studio photography, 85mm portrait lens, soft diffused frontal lighting, realistic shadows, neutral color grading, sharp optical detail, unretouched documentary photography.

Pure white seamless studio background. Exactly one woman, one photograph, one camera angle, no collage, no fashion pose, no accessories, no clothing covering the torso.

subgraphs.name: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 · 1–3 referencias · tamaño libre

nodes.title: KSampler settings
widgets_values:
You can test and find the best setting by yourself. The following table is for reference.
|   | Qwen | Comfy | lightning LoRA |
|--------|---------|------------|---------------------------|
| Steps  | 40      | 20         | 4                         |
| CFG    | 4.0     | 4.0       | 1.0                       |

By default, we use 20 steps as we just don't want it to take too long. Try 40 if you want a better result, but it will take longer.
The "Edit Model Reference Method" nodes above are not needed if you use Comfy files, but may be needed if you use repackaged ones from other people.
